messages:
Samir: heads up — payments-runner started failing to decrypt envelope keys this morning with AccessDenied from KMS.
Samir: log: "User: arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/payments-runner/session-abc is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345"
Samir: happened right after a deploy that uses assumeRole to get creds for the runner.
Josh: check key policy first. could be a conditional deny (principal tags or encryptionContext). also check active grants.
Lena: +1 — if key policy uses aws:PrincipalTag/team or a condition on tags, an assumed role needs session tags to satisfy it.
Samir: our assumeRole call is in Node SDK and we don't pass tags today. code snippet: 
```js
const creds = await sts.assumeRole({ RoleArn, RoleSessionName }).promise();
```
Josh: that won't add principal tags. AWS requires passing Tags + TransitiveTagKeys on AssumeRole (or use pass-session-tags flag) so the session principal carries tags.
infra-bot: NOTICE: CMK abcd-ef01-2345 rotated 2024-11-12T05:24:11Z. Related grants: 1 flagged for re-eval.
Samir: we also saw the rotation alert at ~05:24. could rotation have side-effected grants?
Lena: rotation shouldn't drop the keyId, but grants can be quirky if created against an old principal form. still, the error message points to a policy condition mismatch. check CloudTrail entry for the failed Decrypt to confirm request context.
Josh: pasted cloudtrail snippet: 
```
{
  "eventName": "Decrypt",
  "errorCode": "AccessDeniedException",
  "userIdentity": { "type": "AssumedRole", "arn": "arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/payments-runner/session-abc", "sessionContext": { "attributes": {}, "sessionIssuer": {} } },
  "requestParameters": { "encryptionContext": { "purpose": "envelope" } }
}
```
Josh: no principal tags in the sessionContext. that would break any aws:PrincipalTag check.
Samir: aha. our key policy looks like: 
```json
{ "Sid": "AllowPaymentsTeam", "Effect":"Allow", "Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/payments-runner"}, "Action":"kms:Decrypt", "Condition": { "StringEquals": { "aws:PrincipalTag/team": "payments" } } }
```
Samir: we relied on the role sessions being tagged by the deploy pipeline but apparently they weren't.
Lena: root cause nailed: assumeRole calls didn't include Tags/TransitiveTagKeys, so session lacked the team tag and failed the condition. rotation was a red herring but good to have that flagged.
Josh: mitigation options: 1) update assumeRole calls to include Tags + TransitiveTagKeys (SDK change), 2) temporarily add explicit Allow for the role ARN in the key policy (narrowly scoped), 3) add a fallback grant for the role.
Samir: deployed a quick rollback: added an explicit Allow for the role ARN with a resource-scoped condition (only decrypt envelope keys with encryptionContext purpose=envelope). PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/p/5678
Samir: then pushed SDK change to pass tags: 
```js
await sts.assumeRole({ RoleArn, RoleSessionName, Tags: [{ Key: 'team', Value: 'payments' }], TransitiveTagKeys: ['team'] });
```
deploy-bot: deploy started for payments-runner@staging — build 2024.11.12-119.
Samir: after deploy, decrypts stopped failing. verified CloudTrail shows sessionContext with principalTags now.
Lena: follow-up: create runbook that covers KMS key-policy conditions that depend on principal tags, and add test in e2e pipeline to assert assumeRole tags are passed. also add a note to rotation playbook to check grants. ticket #SEC-412 open.
Josh: thanks — also worth scanning other services that rely on tag-based KMS policies (billing, logs) so we don't have a repeat.
Samir: closing thread. :white_check_mark:
thread_summary: AccessDenied on kms:Decrypt for assumed role. Root cause: assumeRole wasn't passing session tags required by key policy condition (aws:PrincipalTag/team). Rotations flagged but were unrelated. Fix: temporary key-policy allow + SDK change to pass Tags/TransitiveTagKeys; follow-up runbook and ticket created.
